opportunities.title: Regular Grant (under £100,000)
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK registered charities, charitable incorporated organisations (CIOs), exempt and excepted charities; must have at least one year of audited or examined accounts; does not fund individuals, CICs, community benefit societies, social enterprises, local authorities, or activities outside the UK.
opportunities.summary: Open to applications year‑round for operating/core cost grants, capital project grants, or project‑specific activity grants up to £100,000. Grants typically support 10‑20% of an organisation’s annual budget and are awarded on a rolling basis.

opportunities.title: Major Grant (£100,000 and over)
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK charities with annual income over £1 million or projects/capital costs over £1 million; must meet the same eligibility criteria as regular grants (registered charity, audited accounts, etc.).
opportunities.summary: Major Grants are considered at eight board meetings per year and fund capital or project costs of at least £1 million, or core costs for organisations with income over £1 million. Expressions of interest can be submitted any time and are reviewed on a rolling basis.
